{"implementation":"def solve(case):
    threshold = case['threshold']
    calls = case['calls']
    diagnostics = []
    accepted_call_ids = []
    for call in calls:
        call_id = call['call_id']
        parseable = call['parseable']
        loss_without = call['loss_without_call']
        loss_with = call['loss_with_call']
        tokens = call['prediction_tokens']
        gain = loss_without - loss_with
        norm_gain = gain / max(tokens, 1)
        accepted = parseable and norm_gain >= threshold
        diagnostics.append({'accepted': accepted, 'call_id': call_id, 'normalized_gain': norm_gain})
        if accepted:
            accepted_call_ids.append(call_id)
    return {'accepted_call_ids': accepted_call_ids, 'diagnostics': diagnostics}"}
